actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE production game sprite, an independently drawn full-body SOUTH-facing IDLE frame for character 20_star_formation_master_girl from 五行奇谈. One character, one pose, one square image. Native complete single frame 1024x1024 or larger. Actual transparent background alpha; no checkerboard painted into RGB.
Input image 1 is the authoritative character identity reference. Preserve this exact girl, face, large warm ruby-brown eyes, cheerful open smile, very large rounded head, compact short torso and legs, approximately 2.3 heads tall. Dark brown-black long straight hair with high half-up bun, ornate gold star crown, red star side ornament, tiny forehead star, small red tassels. Black and ivory Daoist robes with red front panels, warm gold star/cloud trim, red-gold star belt, loose ivory trousers, black/gold boots. Right hand (viewer left in this front view) holds her short-handled circular charcoal/gold STAR ASTROLABE with concentric orbit rings, central red star jewel and attached short red tassels. Left hand holds exactly THREE connected physical black/gold star talisman cards with red centers. Keep both equipment items complete and attached to hands. No weapon swap, no added equipment.
Input image 2 is the approved PRIMARY RENDERING STYLE reference only: bright clean rounded refined hand-painted Chinese Daoist chibi fantasy, gentle painted volume, crisp readable silhouette, restrained gold materials. Do not copy the UI layout, green costume, male face or text from it. Identity and costume colors remain exactly image 1.
POSE: SOUTH/front, standing still independently, both complete boots grounded naturally at the same baseline, relaxed balanced weight, slightly separated feet, not stepping and not running. Arms comfortably hold original equipment. Camera is fixed game sprite camera, full body facing the viewer, consistent slightly elevated view. Center body axis x=512, grounded sole baseline y=942 on a 1024 square. Keep crown above y=65, all hair, sleeves, cards, tassels and astrolabe inside generous margins. Entire character roughly 870 pixels high. Gentle even light.
Keep opaque costume white areas and clean antialiased alpha edges. Remove any purple/magenta fringe inherited from the reference. No ground shadow, no floor, no background, no particles, no floating stars, no halo, no motion streaks, no border, no words, no multiple panels, no sprite sheet. This is a newly drawn single standing pose, never a crop, mirror or reuse of a walking frame. Highest visual finish supported by the host.

note: Tool exposes no model or quality selector. Reference 1 is derived unchanged identity inspection from original 4096 portrait; no action count.
completed_at_basis: archive time after successful tool return; exact generation timestamp undisclosed
